name: unapproved-admin-group-add
condition: Windows admin group membership event (4728/4732/4756) or explicitly described privileged group addition corroborated by unauthorized/unknown-baseline status and elevated severity
basis: MITRE ATT&CK T1078 Valid Accounts; unauthorized privilege group addition enables abuse of elevated account permissions

name: unexpected-privileged-command
condition: Previously unseen privileged command from ordinary/non-admin account, unapproved elevation and high-severity privilege/valid-account alert
basis: MITRE ATT&CK T1068 Exploitation for Privilege Escalation and T1078 Valid Accounts

name: off-hours-elevation
condition: Off-hours privilege assignment/elevation AND lack of approval or baseline validation, with clear admin-role change and severe alert
basis: MITRE ATT&CK T1078 Valid Accounts; deviations in administrator account privileges merit investigation

name: privilege-review
condition: Unverified admin group change, privileged command, or after-hours admin use without sufficient evidence to justify immediate session denial
basis: MITRE ATT&CK T1068/T1078; uncertain privilege events should be alerted for investigation
